tool_input.command: echo "PWD: $(pwd)"; echo "PROJECT: $GCP_PROJECT"; echo "LOCATION: $GCP_LOCATION"; echo "BQ_DATASET: $GCP_BQ_DATASET"; echo "PREFIX: $MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX"; echo "CREDS: $GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"
ls -la data/; echo "---"; head -20 data/features.csv; echo "---"; wc -l data/features.csv
tool_input.description: Inspect data directory and features file

tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "==="; cut -d, -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | sort -u | head; echo "..."; cut -d, -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | sort -u | tail
tool_input.description: Read schema and inspect date range

tool_input.command: bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" ls "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | head; echo "=== dataset info ==="; bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" show "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | head

tool_input.description: Load features CSV into BigQuery table

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty '
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(event_time) AS mn, MAX(event_time) AS mx, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(event_time)) AS days
FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.features`'
tool_input.description: Verify loaded row count and date range

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
SELECT DATE(event_time) AS d,
  ROUND(AVG(f1),3) f1, ROUND(AVG(f2),3) f2, ROUND(AVG(f3),3) f3,
  ROUND(AVG(f4),3) f4, ROUND(AVG(f5),3) f5, ROUND(AVG(f6),3) f6
FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.features`
GROUP BY d ORDER BY d' 2>/dev/null

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty '
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT DATE(event_time) d, AVG(f2) m FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.features` GROUP BY d
)
SELECT d, ROUND(m,3) f2_mean
FROM daily
WHERE d BETWEEN "2026-02-19" AND "2026-02-24"
ORDER BY d'

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty '
WITH pre AS (SELECT AVG(f1) f1,AVG(f2) f2,AVG(f3) f3,AVG(f4) f4,AVG(f5) f5,AVG(f6) f6
             FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.features` WHERE DATE(event_time) < "2026-02-22"),
post AS (SELECT AVG(f1) f1,AVG(f2) f2,AVG(f3) f3,AVG(f4) f4,AVG(f5) f5,AVG(f6) f6
             FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.features` WHERE DATE(event_time) >= "2026-02-22")
SELECT ROUND(post.f1-pre.f1,3) d_f1, ROUND(post.f2-pre.f2,3) d_f2, ROUND(post.f3-pre.f3,3) d_f3,
       ROUND(post.f4-pre.f4,3) d_f4, ROUND(post.f5-pre.f5,3) d_f5, ROUND(post.f6-pre.f6,3) d_f6
FROM pre, post'
tool_input.description: Compare pre/post means across all features
